name: @ecommerce/web
description: npm workspace root for all web clients and the shared layer they consume
//: Workspaces give ONE node_modules and let @ecommerce/shared be imported by name from every app, with no publish step and no relative ../../.. paths. Crucially it also guarantees React and Angular consume the SAME shared code rather than two copies that drift - which is the whole premise of docs/adr/0014-react-and-angular-in-lockstep.md.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
